summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by reading and editing files only; no tests were run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/tree.py gains Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack-based walk, 4 cells per indent level, max_width passed unchanged). rich/align.py gains Align.__repr__, an Align width constraint (measured maximum, or min with explicit width), and a new public VerticalCenter class with rendering, measurement, and repr. rich/console.py print now uses justify="default" in its render options while still passing justify to _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md 9.8.0 heading marked Unreleased with an Added section containing the two entries. tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gained the requested imports and tests. Verification was by reading only; the tests have not been executed.
